title: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog (Curated Snapshot)

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 2.0-beta9 through 2.15.0 JNDI features do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor mitigation or upgrade to log4j 2.17.1 or later.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Progress MOVEit Transfer SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SQL injection vulnerability in MOVEit Transfer web application that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain access to database.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A command injection vulnerability in GlobalProtect feature allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: PrintNightmare vulnerability in Windows Print Spooler service allows remote code execution with SYSTEM privileges.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows SMBv1 Remote Code Execution (EternalBlue)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: EternalBlue SMBv1 vulnerability allows remote code execution across unpatched systems.
Spring MVC and Spring WebFlux applications running on JDK 9+ may be vulnerable to remote code execution via data binding.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade to Spring Framework 5.3.18 / 5.2.20 or later.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Confluence Broken Access Control Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Broken access control in Confluence Data Center and Server allows unauthenticated attacker to create unauthorized Confluence administrator accounts.
Authentication bypass vulnerability in web component allows remote attacker to access restricted resources.
